title: Headbutt
description:
Deal 9 damage.
Put a card from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] on top of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
upgraded_description:
Deal 12 damage.
Put a card from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] on top of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
notes: Allows selection of a card from the discard pile to place on top of the draw pile after dealing damage.
